title: Notice of Intent Sole Source Stryker OR IP BRAVoE Integration Platform
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.261-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 21 (36C261)
detail_text: The Department of Veteran Affairs, Network Contracting Office 21 (NCO 21), intends to negotiate a sole source Firm-Fixed Price contract for the Stryker Connected OR IP BRAVoE Integration Platform at the San Francisco Veterans Affairs Healthcare System. This synopsis announcment is being issued for information purposes only and does not constitute a solicitaiton or request for competitive proposals.
